comments.author: dantel2017
comments.body_html: Hello, I have a question, do the SCAVS have random armbands, or do they have a specific one to make them more recognizable?

comments.author: Trenchf00t
comments.body_html:
I haven’t given them anything. I don’t even know if eft will spawn them with an armband. I mainly made this because I use pack n’ strap and wanted to use belts. And also Acids progressive bots mod has config options for scavs to have armbands.

I just didn’t see why they shouldn’t be able to loot belts and armbands and equip them.

comments.author: Trenchf00t
comments.body_html: If I’m honest I made this mod in large part because I couldn’t get the idea for that thumbnail out of my head.

comments.author: Piddin
comments.body_html:
I used APBS - Acid’s Progressive Bot System to give scavs and PMCs specific Armbands so it is possible

I changed the files in the DB folder Chances to give scavs 100% armbands chance in each tier, and then in each tier of gear gave them a specific armband (eg twitch) so i recognised them as scavs.

So it is possible to give them armbands and specific ones
